note: The effect palette. Every tile maps to one of the renderer's typed effects (readers/lights/frame.js) with the dials readers/lights/preflight.js gives it, so a tile is the same thing the arranger would place, chosen by a person instead of by the music. `beats` is only the length it arrives at -- the creator drags it. Nothing here is a parameter form: the dials are the tile's identity.

effects.name: Blackout
effects.blurb: The rig goes dark and stays dark.

effects.name: Cut
effects.blurb: The rig drops out for one beat.

effects.name: Impact
effects.blurb: The whole rig, white, on the beat.

effects.name: Flash
effects.blurb: A white flick on the outer pair only.

effects.name: Stab
effects.blurb: A hit on the centre pair, in the song's own colour.

effects.name: Cross
effects.blurb: The hit crosses the room, lamp after lamp.

effects.name: Swell
effects.blurb: A wash that blooms and falls away.

effects.name: Hush
effects.blurb: Levels fall away and the head sinks toward the wall.

effects.name: Hook lift
effects.blurb: Lifts the whole rig and opens the head's prism.

effects.name: Riser
effects.blurb: Colour washes toward white across the span.

effects.name: Fill flicker
effects.blurb: The pars strobe on the front of each beat.

effects.name: Exit dip
effects.blurb: Level and movement ease back together.
